identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2][blocker] Support truthful initialized-phase acceptance and plan-step repair

values.review_scope: Issue #213 exact design, authorize_card_operation change, design-review invalidation, Gate 2 regression proof, lifecycle records, and absence of #205 or broader authority changes.
review_prompts: Are only initialized/ready STP replace_acceptance_criteria and SPP replace_plan_steps newly authorized?
Does either successful repair invalidate design approval without changing phase or granting topology/execution authority?
Do cross-card coverage, semantic validation, CAS, atomic rendering, generation, and append-only audit remain fail closed?
Do focused tests prove both phases, both operations, all rejection boundaries, doctor blocking, and reapproval?
Did the change leave #205 and every publication/merge/terminal boundary untouched?
